title: Issue labels
description: The closed shape of standards/labels.json (or a consumer's LABELS_FILE), checked by scripts/github-settings.sh before any audit or --apply and by scripts/check-label-docs.sh. An empty list is refused: the audit would read every live label as extra and --apply would delete them. Only the draft-07 subset scripts/lib/json-schema.sh implements may be used here.

repos.description: Repos the label applies to; absent means every governed repo. The names are checked against the governed repo set by github-settings.sh, not here.
